Company Description
 
Colorstech Enterprises specializes in Electrical Energy/Power solutions, offering Complete Solar Power Systems and Electronics Devices for residential and commercial use. With expertise in Solar Panels, Inverters, Pumps, Batteries, and more, we provide consultation and a wide range of products for various energy needs. In addition to Solar Power Systems, we also offer a variety of Electrical Supply Driven Inverters and appliances for household and industrial purposes.
 Role Description
 
This is a remote internship opportunity for a Data Engineer Intern at Colorstech Enterprises. The intern will be responsible for tasks related to Data Engineering, Data Modeling, ETL processes, Data Warehousing, and Data Analytics on a day-to-day basis.
 Qualifications
 

- Data Engineering and Data Modeling skills
- Experience in Extract Transform Load (ETL) processes
- Knowledge of Data Warehousing and Data Analytics
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Proficiency in programming languages like Python, SQL, or R
- Understanding of database systems and data management principles
- Pursuing or completed a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field
